scope: 68 individually current-context Rewards/core/canonical/Membership records; no new analyzer run, no production edit. Does not claim target-chain gas, malicious-token universality or independent audit.

records.rationale: _claim authenticates sealed current NFT owner; claimFor admits only that NFT fixed router and ownerOf equality. Amount is taken whole rights then debited before the intended owner ETH call; nonReentrant/economic postcheck and solvency retain rollback. No operator-selected arbitrary recipient.

convertBatch is nonReentrant/economic and onlyKeeper/live/operating. sourceBefore/nativeBefore intentionally bracket the fixed converter; exact source debit and ETH output delta are checked after approval reset. Callback mutation cannot reenter economic writers; admitted-token/converter qualification remains necessary.

convertBatch clears source rights and debits source liability before conversion, then assigns exact received ETH by cumulative whole floors. nonReentrant rejects claims/credit/sync/conversion; claimableComponents, allocationTree and canonicalSeed read barriers reject intermediate accounting. Public mapping reads alone authorize no economic write; external token behavior is qualified separately.

assigned intentionally starts at Solidity zero; each own/shared cumulative output floor subtracts the prior floor then updates it. Thus components sum to exact output and previous assignment is used before each overwrite.
total intentionally starts at zero and accumulates <=32 sorted NFT source components. Checked arithmetic and total==0 rejection precede converter approval/execution.

canonicalExport asset-row struct is zero initialized, then scalar fields and active treeExpected entries are set. Unused 5-tree slots intentionally remain zero and import rejects nonzero unused slots.
_writeSeed found intentionally starts false, scans <=4 actual Vault bucket IDs and rejects if no matching bucket exists before installing any share/collective weights.

cumulative intentionally starts zero for exact converter output apportionment across own/shared components. Each component advances it, ending at total; Math.mulDiv floors cumulative prefixes without leaking leftover output.

_writeSeed installs authenticated actual Vault shares into an initially empty owner leaf; no pending books exist until all seeds finish. Child _roots checks every owner root equals exact Vault supply before node1 and canonicalValidate repeats it. Immediate returned root is intentionally not final during partial seeding.

_writeSeed adds collective weight1 only for exact imported Membership eligibility. All seeds precede node books; child root check before node1/final validate proves total==Membership.totalEligible. Partial seed totals need not yet equal final expected total.

The two assigned writes are separated by next-assigned use for ownETH/sharedETH. They implement cumulative-floor component apportionment, preserving exact total received ETH even for unequal or zero components.

_creditPool is entered only by nonReentrant public credit methods. The cutoff callback targets immutable child, admits only the same parent in source1+canonicalSettling, and only extends captured backing after exact intake. Child does not callback economic state; final state/settling and solvency proofs rollback mutation.

canonicalImport is fixed-Handoff-only nonReentrant/state2. Parent canonicalWrite is immutable-child-only/nonReentrant, restricted to three fixed record domains and no asset transfers. Subsequent balanceOf calls are STATICCALL. Rows/counters cannot be reentered or funds redirected by an imported record.

activate is Vault-only/economic, marks eligible and count BEFORE fixed Rewards.syncMembership. Fresh sync uses only tree math and STATICCALL NFT/Vault/Membership reads, no mutable token/receiver callback. Reentry duplicate activation rejects eligible; final economic state check protects lifecycle. Event after successful sync intentionally represents atomic enrollment.

canonicalCapture clears released flags for <=2 assets before a new authorized source snapshot. Retaining old flags would block restored source funding; bounded reset is intentional.

canonicalImport branches header/asset/seed/node with exact256/320/256/992 lengths, row cursor, lifecycle and typed-parent writer. Complexity expresses distinct proof domains; each bounded branch is reviewed and must be tested separately, rather than removing checks to lower metric.

_books independently validates asset order, expected direct/tree totals, global liability sum, empty collection and absent-ZZZ book. Fixed2assets/5trees bound the work; complexity is required conservation checking, not an arbitrary external call graph.

canonicalWrite has exactly3 immutable-child-only inert import domains. Asset identity/backing, authenticated seed weights, and raw node/phase bounds are separate validations; unknown kinds reject. No arbitrary storage slot/target or calldata executor exists.

Native claim deliberately calls current NFT owner and checks success, under nonReentrant/economic and debited liability. Rejecting receiver rolls back entire claim; public tokens require conventional transfer behavior, no automatic recipient override.

ZZZRewardsCanonical implements the exact IZZZCanonicalModule selectors through structural typing; Handoff calls typed interface. Explicit inheritance is stylistic and cannot add authority/funding protection; ABI closure was typechecked.

Rewards structurally implements claimFor used by fixed NFT claim router; current NFT owner equality and exact payout checks are explicit. Inheriting IZZZClaimLedger would be documentation-only and not change callable permission.

LP_ALLOCATION_VERSION is an intentional exact capability selector matching new Rewards getter1. Case is part of typed interface/profile admission, not an uninitialized value or authority path.
